svg.title: PIDC with $k_{\max} = 4$: the sweeps of four windows run at once once the pipeline is full
svg.desc: Numerical experiment plot titled PIDC with $k_{\max} = 4$: the sweeps of four windows run at once once the pipeline is full. Quantitative values are provided in the accompanying JSON and report.
